description: The image displays three separate pie charts, each illustrating the proportional distribution of different categories or operations within a specific reasoning domain. The middle chart, "Approximate Number Generation," contains four segments: "Absolute Absence" (18.71%, light purple), "Comparative Relationships" (36.26%, medium blue), "Approximate Quantities" (45.03%, beige), and one unlabeled segment (the remaining 10.00%, light gray). The rightmost chart, "Disjunctive & Conjunctive," is split into two nearly equal parts: "Disjunctive" (49.51%, light lavender) and "Conjunctive" (50.49%, light pink). All three charts include percentage labels directly within their respective slices and are presented without any legend or additional visual emphasis such as exploded sections.
